resources.string: Connect private repositories securely; public repository links work without setup.
Saved credential is no longer valid

Public repositories need no token. For private repositories, the token is verified directly with GitHub and encrypted with Android Keystore. It is never added to prompts, tool arguments, or request logs.
Use a fine-grained token limited to selected repositories with Contents: read access.
Recommended scope: only the repositories you need, with read-only Contents permission. Do not use a classic token unless you have a specific compatibility requirement.
